What is missing from this page

Verdict classifications for 2009 are withheld. 79% of the archive rows for this year carry an identical “All-Time Blockbuster” classification, which is not a real distribution — these rows were seeded from a curated list of the year’s biggest films and inherited one verdict. Some titles are also filed under the wrong release year. Collection figures are shown as held; verdicts are not shown until the archive is re-verified.
